candidates.name: Single Leg Bicycle
candidates.cardText:
Single Leg Bicycle
Novice
1
Lie supine, one knee bent, opposite leg extended.
2
Press through one leg. Simultaneously pull the raised leg up to a table top position.
3
As you lower, bring your non-working leg back into extension.

candidates.name: Single Leg One Leg Bent
candidates.cardText:
Single Leg One Leg Bent
Novice
1
Lie supine, one foot planted, opposite leg in a tabletop position.
2
Engage core, maintain neutral pelvis.

candidates.name: Footwork High Half Toe
candidates.cardText:
Footwork High Half Toe
Novice
1
Lie supine, balls of feet on bar, heels lifted high.
2
Press bar away, extending legs while maintaining lifted heels.
3
Keep pelvis neutral, ribs down, and core engaged.
4
Bend knees to return smoothly, maintaining ankle stability and control.

candidates.name: Footwork Heels On The Bar
candidates.cardText:
Footwork Heels On The Bar
Novice
1
Lie supine, heels on bar hip-width, toes lifted slightly.
2
Press bar away, fully extending legs without locking knees.
3
Maintain neutral pelvis, ribs down, and steady core engagement.
4
Bend knees to return with control, keeping heels connected.

candidates.name: Running Lying On The Back
candidates.cardText:
Running Lying On The Back
Novice
1
Lie supine with feet on bar, legs fully extended.
2
Alternate lowering one heel while the other stays lifted.
3
Switch rhythmically, maintaining stable pelvis and quiet upper body.
4
Continue alternating, emphasizing ankle mobility and control.

candidates.name: Hip Rolls
candidates.cardText:
Hip Rolls
Beginner
1
Lie supine with knees bent, feet hip-width, arms relaxed by sides.
2
Inhale to prepare, exhale and posteriorly tilt pelvis.
3
Roll spine up one vertebra at a time into bridge.
4
Press through legs until legs are nearly extended. Lower back to start.
5
Then begin rolling your spine downward until your back is flat against the carriage.

candidates.name: Hip Lift
candidates.cardText:
Hip Lift
Novice
1
Lie supine with knees bent, feet hip-width and flat. Hips slightly off the carriage.
2
Engage core and glutes, press through heels.
3
Maintain hip position as you press.

candidates.name: Pilates Short Spine
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Short Spine
Intermediate
1
Lie supine, feet in straps, legs extended upward.
2
Lift hips, rolling spine off carriage.
3
Bend knees, bringing heels toward glutes overhead.
4
Roll down slowly, extending legs to start.

candidates.name: Pilates Footwork First Position
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Footwork First Position
Beginner
1
Lie on reformer, heels together, toes apart on footbar.
2
Press carriage out by extending legs evenly.
3
Keep pelvis stable and core engaged.
4
Bend knees to return with control.

candidates.name: Pilates Single Leg Heel
candidates.cardText:
Pilates Single Leg Heel
Beginner
1
Lie on reformer, one heel on footbar, other leg extended.
2
Press carriage out using working leg.
3
Keep hips level and core engaged.
4
Bend knee to return with control.
